checks.result: Confirmed on the provider page: Riverfront Library Pantry, Monday to Friday, 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., while supplies last. The library branch page gives the address One Larkin Center, Yonkers, NY 10701.

Confirmed on the provider locations page: 30 South Broadway, Yonkers, NY 10701, with the weekday hours listed. The center homepage describes affordable care for all patients regardless of ability to pay.

Confirmed on the provider page: 2 Park Avenue, Yonkers, NY 10703, medical hours Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. The Sun River Health insurance page states a sliding fee scale for uninsured patients.

Confirmed on the provider page: drop-in shelter for homeless men and women at 87 South Broadway, Yonkers, NY 10701, up to 50 women and 60 men nightly, with meals daily. The page states no clock hours.
Confirmed on the provider page: food pantry twice per month, first and third Monday, 12:00 to 2:00 p.m., with registration by photo ID and proof of address. The page states no street address.
Confirmed on the provider page: St. John's Food Pantry each Wednesday at 9:00 a.m., distributing fresh food. The page states no end time and no street address.

Confirmed on the provider page: Project Connect offers street outreach in Yonkers and a program space with showers, meals, and temporary shelter, described as a 24 hour drop-in center. The page states no street address.

listings.offer: Community health center care, including internal medicine, pediatrics, dental, and behavioral health. The center says it provides affordable care to all patients regardless of ability to pay.

listings.offer: Drop-in shelter for homeless men and women. The Women's Drop-in accommodates up to 50 women nightly and the Men's Drop-in up to 60 men, with an overflow site for up to 35 men. Clients receive breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks daily.
